name: nucleation_manual_engine_click
description: The same engine, placed with room to fly: padded to the east end of the capture's chunk so nothing crosses the frozen chunk border. Placement runs the first two steps (ticks 0-25); the world then goes quiet; a right-click on the note block — at [13,0,2], where the machine's two steps left it — cycles its pitch on tick 30, the observers see the change, and the engine runs a complete second activation through tick 55. Fifty-five ticks, two full activations, one of them started by the player-input path. (From Nucleation, MIT, (c) 2025 Schem-at.)
